answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Deviant Sects Question ID: 36362 Country: India Title: List out the differences which Ahl Hadith have with majority due to which they are eviant. Question: List out the differences which Ahl Hadith have with majority due to which they are eviant. Answer ID: 36362 Posted on: Dec 18, 2023 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 582/277/L=1433) In order to know the different masails of Ghair Muqallidin, study the books ’Adilla Kamila’, ‘Mutala Ghair Muqallidiyat’, ’Radd Ghair Muqallidiyat’ etc. Ahl Hadith differ from the majority in many unanimous masail. They also consider the furooi masail as definite and propagate it severely. Also they declare weak ahadith completely null and void. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
